config.comment.areamode:
OFF: Only fill the container you are currently looking at.
ON: Automatically scan all containers within the specified radius.
config.comment.autostashitems: When enabled, automatically stashes unrelated items into a Shulker Box if your inventory is full to free up space.
config.comment.cacheentrylimit:
Entry limit for the primary cache.
Higher values reduce repeated requests for older containers in large builds, but use more memory.
config.comment.cachettl:
Time-to-live for container data cache entries in seconds. When a cached entry expires, the next request for that container will re-fetch data from the server.
Set lower (e.g. 10s) for fresher data but more network requests; set higher to reduce request frequency.
config.comment.carpetlargebarrelmode:
Controls support for Carpet's largeBarrels rule.
Off: always treat barrels as normal single barrels.
On: always merge two back-to-back barrels into one large barrel. Only enable this on servers where Carpet largeBarrels is enabled.
config.comment.clickpacketratelimit: Maximum automated container click packets sent per game tick when Slow Click Packets is enabled.
config.comment.collectmateriallistitemsc: When enabled, Collect Materials closes the opened container after processing. Disable it if you want to inspect the container after collection.
config.comment.collectmateriallistitemsr: When enabled, Collect Materials leaves a small reserve in each source container slot instead of taking the entire stack.
Number of items to leave in each matching source slot when Collect Materials retain mode is enabled.
config.comment.containerclearoutputmode:
Controls where items go when the Clear Container tool removes them.
Drop: throws them onto the ground.
Inventory: quick-moves them into your inventory and aborts if there is not enough space.
Inventory + Drop: tries inventory first, then drops anything left.
config.comment.containerfilterlist: Container block IDs used by the whitelist/blacklist. Supports * wildcards, for example minecraft:*_shulker_box. Non-vanilla containers can be added manually by block ID; the mod also tries to recognise common inventory block entities automatically.
config.comment.containerfiltermode: Choose whether the container filter list is disabled, used as a whitelist, or used as a blacklist.
config.comment.containerfilterscope:
Controls which features use the container filter.
Projection Fill: schematic filling, area fill, manual schematic fill, and container highlights.
Container Tools: clear, fill-full, sync, and packing tools.
Both: applies the same filter everywhere.
config.comment.containertoolmode:
Selected tool for the unified container tool hotkey.
Clear: empties the looked-at container.
Fill Full: fills it from inventory with one unambiguous item type.
Sync: first reads a template container, then copies that layout into same-type target containers.
Container Packing: moves the looked-at container contents into inventory shulker boxes, preferring boxes already holding the same item, then any box with free space.
Collect Materials: moves missing Litematica material-list items from the opened/looked-at container into your inventory.
Container Packing is skipped when no quick-shulker support is available.
config.comment.continuousfill: When enabled, the mod will automatically scan for and fill missing containers.
config.comment.creativefill: When enabled, required items will be printed from thin air in Creative mode, ignoring inventory limitations.
config.comment.debuglogpca: Show PCA sync protocol debug messages.
config.comment.debuglogperf: Show detailed performance/hotspot timing for fill operations.
config.comment.debugmode: Master switch for all debug logging. Sub-categories on the Debug tab can be toggled individually.
config.comment.dropextracteditems: When enabled, incorrect or excess items will be dropped on the ground instead of being returned to your inventory.
config.comment.dropitemsfromemptyschemat: When enabled, if a schematic container is empty but the real container contains items, filling may throw those real items out. Warning: this can drop valuable items on the ground.
config.comment.enablecarpetlargebarrels:
When enabled, the mod will treat two bottom-connected barrels as a single large double barrel (requires Carpet mod's 'largeBarrels' rule on the server).
If your server does not have large barrels enabled, keep this OFF to prevent barrel slot offset issues.
config.comment.enabledatasync: Receive PCA data to view container contents through walls without opening them.
config.comment.enablefillstateprotection: When enabled, the fill work state is automatically turned off when leaving the world, switching worlds or dimensions, changing player session, or dying/respawning.
config.comment.enablemod: Enable or disable the core features of the Container Filler.
config.comment.enableopnbtquery: When enabled and you have server OP permissions, the mod will actively request data for unopened containers from the server.
config.comment.enableqsextraction: Automatically open Shulker Boxes in your inventory to extract required items when materials run out.
config.comment.enablesafetydelay:
Disabling this will make the machine ignore all safety delays and fill at maximum speed (may cause bugs or result in a server kick).
Use with caution.
config.comment.enablesynctoolqsextractio:
When enabled, the Sync Container tool may open quick shulker boxes or use TakeItOut to fetch missing template items.
When disabled, Sync Container only uses items already in the player inventory.
config.comment.enabletoolholdrepeat:
When enabled, holding the container tool execute key repeats the selected tool.
A short tap still runs once; pressing again while a tool is running cancels it.
Holding repeats Clear, Fill Full, or Sync on the currently looked-at container.
config.comment.enabletoolhud:
When enabled, shows the selected container tool and action hint
near the crosshair while looking at a container.
config.comment.filldelay: Delay between automated fill actions (in Ticks). Higher is slower.
config.comment.fillradius: Fill radius for Area Fill Mode (0 - 1024 blocks, 0 means unlimited).
config.comment.hidefillergui: Legacy hide UI option, kept only for migrating old config files.
config.comment.hideprojectionfillgui: Hide automatically opened container screens during projection fill work.
config.comment.hidetoolgui: Hide automatically opened container screens while container tools are running.
config.comment.highlightcolorfilling: Colour for the animated marker above the container currently being filled. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolormissingmate: Colour for containers skipped because materials are missing. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcoloroverfilled: Colour when the items and slots are correct, but the amount exceeds the requirement, or there are extra items. Default: Pink. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorpartial: Colour when the container has required items but not enough, or in the wrong slots. Default: Yellow. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorqueued: Colour for queued-container waiting markers. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorsatisfied: Colour when the container perfectly matches the schematic. Default: Green. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorunfilled: Colour when the container is completely empty but the schematic requires items. Default: Blue. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorunknown: Colour when the real container data has not yet been fetched from the server. Default: Orange. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorunplaced: Colour when the schematic has a container but the real world has no placed container there. Default: Slate. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcolorwrong: Colour when the container holds completely wrong items compared to the schematic. Default: Red. Use hex ARGB format.
config.comment.highlightcontainers: Highlights missing, incorrect, or unsynced schematic containers in the world with wireframes.
config.comment.highlightdatarequestbudge:
Maximum number of highlight-related container data requests sent to the cache layer each tick.
Higher values reveal unknown containers faster, but increase main-thread and network processing load.
config.comment.highlightemptyschematicco: When enabled, containers that are empty in the schematic but contain items in the real world will be highlighted as overfilled/excess.
config.comment.highlightglassalphamultip: Opacity multiplier for the translucent highlight body.
config.comment.highlightscanbudget:
Maximum number of highlight candidate containers re-evaluated each tick.
Higher values load large schematic highlights faster, but make FPS drops more likely while highlights are enabled.
config.comment.highlighttopplatesize: Size of the top highlight plate.
config.comment.highlightunplacedcontaine: Render schematic containers that do not currently have a matching placed container block in the real world.
config.comment.highlightxray: When enabled, container highlights render through terrain and blocks (X-Ray).
config.comment.interactionreach: Override the player's block interaction reach distance. Set to 0 to use the vanilla default (Creative: 5, Survival: 4.5). Increase this if your server has extended reach (e.g. via Carpet playerModifier).
config.comment.matchshulkerboxesbyconten:
When enabled, Shulker Boxes with different colors are considered fill-compatible if their internal items, counts, and slots match.
When disabled, shulker boxes still require exact item ID and component equality.
config.comment.materialreplacements:
Global rules that replace required container items in every schematic.
Format: source_id->target_id (e.g. minecraft:stone->minecraft:cobblestone).
Use minecraft:air as the target to ignore that item; it will not be filled.
The visual replacement UI can also save per-schematic rules and exact item components such as custom names, enchantments and other data components.
If both a per-schematic rule and a global rule match the same item, the per-schematic rule has priority.
Custom-name matching uses #, for example minecraft:paper#slot1->minecraft:iron_ingot.
Multiple rules can be added.
config.comment.maxqueuedrenderoverlays: Maximum number of queued-container markers to render at once. Lower values improve FPS in large container piles.
config.comment.pcasyncrequestspertick:
Maximum number of PCA container sync requests sent each game tick.
Set to 0 for unlimited, which tries to flush the waiting queue within the same tick.
config.comment.pcasyncretrycooldownticks:
If a PCA request does not receive a response within a short time, it is treated as failed.
This sets how many game ticks the same position must wait before another PCA request is allowed. Set to 0 to retry immediately after a failure.
config.comment.quickshulkeropenmode:
Invoke: use QuickShulker's open packet and requires QuickShulker to be installed.
Simulate Click: simulate a right click on the shulker slot in the player inventory, for other quick-shulker-like mods that listen to GUI right clicks.
config.comment.ratelimitclickpackets: Compatibility mode for plugin servers and anti-cheat environments. When enabled, automated container click packets are queued and sent slowly. Keep this off on normal servers.
config.comment.renderfillingarrow: Render a flat animated marker above the container currently being filled.
config.comment.rendermissingmaterialmark: Render markers above containers skipped because required materials are missing.
config.comment.renderqueuedspinner: Render animated waiting markers above queued containers.
config.comment.renderradius: Render radius for missing container highlights (0 - 1024 blocks).
config.comment.renderstateglass: Render the translucent full-block highlight body.
config.comment.renderstateoverfilled: Render containers with extra items or excessive item counts.
config.comment.renderstatepartial: Render containers that contain some required items but are not complete.
config.comment.renderstatesatisfied: Render containers that already match the schematic.
config.comment.renderstatetopplate: Render the small top plate that makes highlighted containers easier to identify.
config.comment.renderstateunfilled: Render containers that are empty but need items.
config.comment.renderstateunknown: Render containers whose real inventory data has not been synchronized yet.
config.comment.renderstatewrong: Render containers that contain wrong item types.
config.comment.storeorderly:
Projection filling frees inventory space with a speed-first ordered strategy.
Items taken from shulker boxes are put back into their source or matching shulker boxes first. If none are available, unrelated items not needed by the current task are stashed into the first suitable shulker box.
config.comment.synclitelayer: When enabled, highlights and filling actions will only apply to containers within the current Litematica render layer.
config.comment.taskmarkeranimationfps: Maximum animation rebuild rate for filling, queued, and missing-material markers. 0 means unlimited.
config.comment.taskoverlaylingerticks: How long a transient task marker remains after a fill operation finishes.
config.comment.toolclearmode:
Toggle the clear container tool.
Use the clear trigger hotkey to process only the container you are looking at.
config.comment.toolcopymode:
Toggle the sync container tool.
First trigger reads the looked-at container as a template.
Later triggers sync the looked-at container.
config.comment.toolenabled:
Enables the selected container tool.
Switch Container Tool: cycles the selected mode.
Switch Previous: cycles backward.
Execute Container Tool: runs it on the looked-at container.
Close All Tool Modes: disables tools and fill work.
config.comment.toolfillfullmode:
Toggle the fill-full tool.
Use the fill-full trigger hotkey to process only the container you are looking at.
config.comment.toolfillfullthreshold: Fill Full chooses an inventory item only when that exact item stack type occupies at least this many inventory slots and can be inserted into the target container. If multiple item types tie for best match, nothing is moved.
config.comment.toolhudborder:
When enabled, draws the bright border around the Tool HUD card.
Turn it off for a cleaner, flatter panel.
config.comment.toolhudcustomx: Horizontal HUD card offset relative to the screen crosshair. You can drag the HUD card in the render editor.
config.comment.toolhudcustomy: Vertical HUD card offset relative to the screen crosshair. You can drag the HUD card in the render editor.
config.comment.toolhudframerate: Maximum update rate for tool HUD layout and animation. 0 means unlimited.
config.comment.toolhudiconscale: Scales only the animated icon inside the tool HUD card. 100 matches the card scale.
config.comment.toolhudoffset:
Fixed Card: horizontal distance from the screen centre.
Anchored Card: screen-space distance between the selected container marker and the tool HUD panel.
config.comment.toolhudopacity: Controls the transparency of the container tool HUD panel.
config.comment.toolhudscale: Scales the tool HUD card, including its panel and icons. 100 is the default size.
config.comment.toolhudsmoothing: Controls how smoothly the tool HUD animation updates. Lower values feel softer but slower.
config.comment.toolhudstyle:
Fixed Card: a clean information card stays in a stable screen position without anchor lines.
Anchored Card: the older style that points from the selected container to the HUD card.
config.comment.toolrepeatsamecontainerco:
Cooldown in ticks before hold-repeat may run again on the same container.
Useful for stations where the player keeps aiming at one container while items are refilled or replaced.
config.comment.workingstate: When enabled, the mod continuously scans and fills reachable containers within the area fill radius. The hotkey can be configured on the same row. The manual fill hotkey still only handles the container you are looking at.
config.name.dropitemsfromemptyschematicc: Drop Items from Empty Schematic Containers
litematica_container_filler.gui.label.re: Tune the container body style and state colors. Changes are saved immediately.
Tune the optional container tool HUD. Tool HUD is off by default and can be enabled here.
Tune the animated filling, queued, and missing-material markers. The FPS limit controls animation rebuild rate.

In small windows, custom resolutions, or unusual aspect ratios, this editor may be misaligned or hard to click.
If that happens, use a larger window or default GUI scale before editing these options.
Clear all replacement rules saved for this schematic. Global item replacement rules are not changed.
Open the visual container filter picker.
Clears the primary cache and discards the pending PCA sync queue. Container data will be synchronized again on demand.
Number of positions currently waiting in the PCA sync queue.
Number of entries in the primary cache consumed by the mod.
Unique position count after merging the primary cache and the pending PCA queue.
Open a visual picker for global item replacement rules.
Litematica ignore only hides this entry from the material list. To ignore it during filling, use Replace -> Ignore Item.
Switch the material list view between building blocks, container contents calculated by this mod, and both together.
Open this mod's item replacement picker.
Replace this item with air. The filler will treat it as ignored and will not fill it, not just hide it from the material list.
This item is displayed after a replacement rule.
Clear only this item's replacement rule in the selected scope. Other replacement rules are not changed.

Choose where the replacement rule is saved. This Schematic only affects the current schematic placement; Global affects all schematics. If both match the same item, this schematic's rule has priority.

config.comment.cyclemanualoverride: Cycles the looked-at schematic container between Auto, Manually Completed, and Manually Needs Fill.
config.comment.fillcontainer: Press this key to immediately execute a fill action.
config.comment.openconfiggui: Hotkey to open this mod's configuration menu (Default: L + C).
config.comment.togglecontinuous: Quickly toggle the background 'Continuous Fill' feature on or off.
config.comment.togglemode: Quickly switch between 'Single Gaze Mode' and 'Area Scan Mode'.
config.comment.toolcleartrigger: Run the clear container tool once on the looked-at container.
config.comment.toolcloseall: Disable the fill work state and all container tool modes.
config.comment.toolfillfulltrigger: Run the fill-full tool once on the looked-at container.
config.comment.toolswitchmode: Cycle the selected container tool and enable the tool HUD.
config.comment.toolswitchprevious: Cycle the selected container tool backward.
config.comment.toolsynctrigger: Read or sync the looked-at container.
config.comment.tooltrigger: Run the currently selected container tool on the looked-at container.
